description: Development evaluation corpus for Sprint 5 semantic validation, confidence calibration, clarification, and abstention testing.

cases.question: How many customers are registered in total?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS customer_count FROM customers LIMIT 50;

cases.question: How many orders do we have in total?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS order_count FROM orders LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What is the total quantity of items sold across all order items?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What is the highest unit price among all products?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT MAX(unit_price) AS max_price FROM products LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What is the lowest unit price among all products?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT MIN(unit_price) AS min_price FROM products LIMIT 50;

cases.question: How many orders are there by status?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT status, COUNT(id) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What is the average unit price by product category?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT category, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category LIMIT 50;

cases.question: How many completed orders do we have?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: How many cancelled orders are recorded?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: How many pending orders exist?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS pending_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What is our total revenue from completed orders?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What is the total completed revenue by product category?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS category_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category LIMIT 50;

cases.question: Show top 5 customers by completed revenue
cases.referenceSql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

cases.question: What is the total quantity of items sold by product category?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category LIMIT 50;

cases.question: How many orders has each customer placed?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name LIMIT 50;

cases.question: How many distinct orders contain electronics products?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS distinct_orders FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'electronics' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What is the completed revenue for electronics products?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS electronics_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category = 'electronics' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: Show top 10 products by completed revenue
cases.referenceSql: SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS product_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY product_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

cases.question: How many unique customers have placed completed orders?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS active_customers FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What is the total quantity of items sold in completed orders?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS completed_quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What was our total revenue from completed orders last month?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-03-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-04-01' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: How many orders were placed last month?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2026-03-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-04-01' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: How many orders were placed in the last 30 days?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2026-03-16' AND ordered_at <= '2026-04-15' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What was the completed revenue in Q1 2026?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS q1_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-04-01' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: How many customers registered this year?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS new_customers FROM customers WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND created_at < '2027-01-01' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: How many completed orders were placed yesterday?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND ordered_at >= '2026-04-14' AND ordered_at < '2026-04-15' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What was our completed revenue by product category last month?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-03-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY p.category LIMIT 50;

cases.question: How many orders were placed in the last 7 days?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2026-04-08' AND ordered_at <= '2026-04-15' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What was the total quantity sold last year?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-01-01' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: How many orders were cancelled last month?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS cancelled_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND ordered_at >= '2026-03-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-04-01' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What is the average order value for completed orders?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS average_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What is our total revenue for books in completed orders?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS books_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category = 'books' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: What is our total revenue for clothing in completed orders?
cases.referenceSql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS clothing_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category = 'clothing' LIMIT 50;

cases.question: Total orders and unique orders by status for completed orders
